rooms.description: A continuous band of slanted windows silhouettes the bolted navigation console against a tilted blue-grey sea. Radar and weather displays sit beneath the glass, with a radio handset, log station and stubby noticeboard at either end.

From above bench height, two steel benches slash across a teal anti-slip floor. Hard strip light catches beads of water on the pipe elbows, sample bottles in slotted racks and a pump beneath the sampling manifold.
rooms.feeling: Clammy and loud, with a vibration you can almost feel.

rooms.description: At keyboard height, a tiled monitor wall fills the frame with muted violet traces over dark glass. Squared stacks of scientific notes sit between keyboards, and the screen wash picks out the straight edge of the bolted desk.
rooms.feeling: Hushed enough to hear a single keypress.

rooms.description: A round bolted table fills the foreground beneath a broad amber ceiling diffuser. Mismatched mugs crowd a coffee pot, with a chipped orange rim nearest us. A small galley, latched refrigerator and curling noticeboard sit behind.
rooms.feeling: Familiar warmth with the lull of a meal between shifts.

rooms.description: The doorway frames an open rectangle of pale green vinyl beside a narrow examination bed. Diffuse white light washes the floor. Flush cabinet latches, a dark diagnostic monitor and a shallow report desk line the walls.

From knee height, eight narrow cabin doors run in two rows of four toward an intersecting passage. Warm yellow light from the far doorway skims worn thresholds, catches a heel scuff and silhouettes the nearest latch.
rooms.feeling: Intimate and quiet enough to make footsteps feel intrusive.

rooms.description: A gooseneck lamp pools over an open laptop, coiled headphones and red camera straps on an old survey desk. Two dark monitors crowd the bulkhead. Charging leads curl around battery docks beneath pinned sheets of thumbnail sketches.

Tall racks of blue parts bins rise to exposed ceiling ribs. A caged work light cuts across hanging spanners, clipped diagrams and a scarred vise. A meter and a stout maintenance terminal sit on the bolted bench.
rooms.feeling: Brisk, noisy and ready for the next repair.

people.description: Broad jacket shoulders taper to a slim waist as he leans toward you. A swept side part and violet pocket square frame a long, clean-shaven face. He meets your eye, one palm lifted, thumb already curling inward.
people.feeling: Easy charm with a quick tempo.

people.description: Tall and straight through the shoulders, she clasps her hands behind a slate-blue uniform jacket. Hard side light edges a close-cropped silver head and high cheekbones. Her level eyes settle just beyond the viewer.

Seated, she has narrow shoulders and a thick teal fleece that bunches at the waist beneath a sleeveless vest. Screen glow catches her round cheeks and loose topknot as she looks up, glasses dangling from two fingers.

Short-necked and stocky, he hunches inside boxy coveralls with a faded orange shoulder stripe. A pool of work light catches his buzz cut and blunt, stubbled chin. He looks down, drawing a rag between grease-darkened fingers.
people.feeling: Matter-of-fact concentration at the end of a long watch.

people.description: Soft light rounds her full upper arms beneath a loose sage scrub top. She leans back, hands folded just inside the crop. A chin-length bob cups her small, freckled face as her eyes move sideways toward the speaker.
people.feeling: Patient attention that leaves room for a pause.

people.description: Lanky in a fitted windbreaker with a red zip, he stands sideways with hands in his pockets and one shoulder hitched high. Window light separates unruly curls from his narrow profile as his eyes follow movement down the passage.
people.feeling: Curiosity that keeps finding somewhere else to look.
